notes.title: Update!!! New Game Play Mode Available
notes.notes:
Today an update will be coming out that makes a few changes to the game.
1. NEW GAME PLAY MODE added Challenge mode.  This new game mode adds a few new game pieces as well as a couple of special pieces that serve different functions.
2.  Added setting to change and customize the color of the play grid in game.
3.  Fixed error causing excessively long startup time.
4.  Fixed error causing memory leak with backgrounds from steam directory.
5.  Fixed miscellaneous errors and adjusted game difficulty.

Thanks and remember to send any suggestions you have to make Brick Stack VR better. ;)

notes.title: Update!!! New Features
notes.notes:
An update will be coming today with a few exciting changes:

1. Settings to change the volume of music and sound effects in the game.
2. The new ability to change the background in game using any background that you have available in your SteamVR library.*
3. General performance improvements and optimization.

*Note if your Steam and SteamVR installation are not in the default directory the game may be unable to locate your backgrounds.
